problem_type: Capacitated p-median location (Capacitated p-Median): select exactly p of the n customers as medians and assign each customer to one selected median, such that the total demand served by each median does not exceed capacity, minimizing the total assignment distance Σ_i distance_matrix[i][assignments[i]]. All constraints are hard. If the input has no feasible solution, status = "infeasible" must be reported explicitly.

decisions.business: Solving verdict: "feasible" means a solution satisfying all constraints is given; "infeasible" means the instance is determined to have no feasible solution.
decisions.shape: str, value must be either "feasible" or "infeasible"
decisions.completeness: Required. When "infeasible", medians and assignments must both be empty lists []; no partial solution violating constraints may be output.

decisions.business: Set of customer indices selected as medians (facilities), i.e., all j with y[j] = 1.
decisions.shape: list[int], length exactly p, elements are distinct integers in 0..n-1, ascending order recommended (order does not affect the meaning of the solution)
decisions.completeness: When status is "feasible", must contain exactly p distinct indices in 0..n-1. A selected median may serve no customers (including itself), but must still be listed. [] when status is "infeasible".

decisions.business: Median to which each customer is assigned: assignments[i] = j means customer i is assigned to median j, i.e., x[i][j] = 1. A median is not required to be assigned to itself; it may be assigned to another selected median.
decisions.shape: list[int], length n, axis 0 is customer index i (0..n-1), values are median indices j (0..n-1)
decisions.example: For n=4, medians=[0, 2]: [0, 0, 2, 2], meaning customers 0 and 1 are assigned to median 0, and customers 2 and 3 are assigned to median 2
decisions.completeness: When status is "feasible", the length must be exactly n, with no customer omitted. Every value must appear in medians. For each j in medians, the sum of demands[i] over all customers with assignments[i] = j must be ≤ capacity. The objective value is Σ_i distance_matrix[i][assignments[i]]. [] when status is "infeasible".
